improvements: Current native scene retains 114 source building records and validates the source geometry cache; no membership count establishes architectural parity.
Physical elevator entrance; retained animated ascent, seven phone mode cancellations, manually aimed Loupe shutter and phone persistence
The selected primary activity approach is accepted separately from full-scene comparison.

District fidelity pass, 6ccf348 / 0446b77 (range 332ae423..346f7986): In the shared Seattle Center scene the MoPOP lobes reach the ground in steel (the outline volume w161587742 and the duplicate Sky Church room w1092469435 are no longer drawn as plain walls). The Needle itself was not changed by the pass.
Fidelity pass round 2, 9824fd5 (range 94a177d5..9824fd56): Seattle Center: skyline culling of the mapped city; the Chihuly Glasshouse is a declared interior (no snow inside).

Fidelity pass round 3, 2b1a251 (range 9824fd56..2b1a2511): Seattle Center: the International Fountain (bowl, dome, jets, asphalt apron), the Olympic Iliad, the Climate Pledge Arena shape and the monorail station canopy with its ALWEG sign.
remainingGaps: Unsupported stair/deck teleport and lm-needle-360 are retired; full tower/skyline comparison remains separate
Complete matched independent scene, entry and architectural/reference comparison remains open; source membership and cache hits are not visual parity.
Route/controller proof does not certify every secondary activity, completed-save persistence or full phone-thumbstick coverage.
Unmodelled stair/deck teleport and lm-needle-360 are retired. The animated elevator and manually aimed Loupe remain; no actual stair access is asserted.
Validation frames, native proofs, source-geometry counts and performance figures in this record predate 2b1a251 and were not re-run for round 3.

review: Inspected current native GAME arrival/approach/phone views and linked scoped activity proof. Physical elevator entrance; retained animated ascent, seven phone mode cancellations, manually aimed Loupe shutter and phone persistence Unsupported stair/deck teleport and lm-needle-360 are retired; full tower/skyline comparison remains separate Older context images and audits retain their original source/date in collapsed history. nativeProofs.label: Current native scene, phone conditions and selected activity approach
nativeProofs.scope: All current load/cache/phone-condition/retained-count checks pass. The selected activity coordinate is physically reached; this is not completion of every activity.

nativeProofs.label: Native phone manual view/tracking and shutter
nativeProofs.scope: Actual touch look and unobstructed native shutter events; selected exercise completes and persists. MoPOP retains a missed pass, waits for real animation frames and reacquires the moving train. Initial nearby setup is explicit.

nativeProofs.label: Native phone elevator cancellation
nativeProofs.scope: Seven real host-mode cancellations restore the original floor without an award. A separate animated ascent reaches the Loupe. The later shutter locator failure is retained; successful Loupe controls are separate.
